# booth-image-to-model

> booth-image-to-model turns one exhibition-booth photo or render into an editable parametric 3D model (a JSON spec), a Blender scene and clean client renders — as an AI-agent skill or a local web studio.

Key facts:
- Two ways to use it: (A) an agent skill (`booth-image-to-model/SKILL.md`) for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor or any agent that can look at images and run shell commands; (B) a local web studio (`python web/server/run.py`, http://127.0.0.1:8800/) that reads the picture with any OpenAI-compatible model.
- Output: a parametric spec in metres (`spec.json`, schema booth-spec-v2), a `.blend` file, a clean client render without the hall, neighbouring stands, logos or people, a second view, and a GLB.
- Method: corner points fit the camera and scale (`box_fit`); parts are unprojected from pixels into metres; the model is validated and built in a fresh Blender process and reopened to check.
- Not a CAD tool: dimensions are estimates from one picture and every assumption is recorded.
- Requirements: Python 3.10+ with numpy, Pillow, SciPy, jsonschema and trimesh; Blender 4.0+ (5.2.2 tested) for `.blend` files and renders.
- Privacy: the skill makes no network calls; the studio sends a picture only to the configured model service and only after per-picture consent; the API key stays in memory.
- License: Apache-2.0. Repository: https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model (formerly Booth2CAD).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/README.md): what it is, the two ways in, requirements, FAQ
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese version
- [Skill README](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/booth-image-to-model/README.md): installing the skill in an agent
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/booth-image-to-model/SKILL.md): the step-by-step route the agent follows
- [Web studio and editor](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/web/README.md): running the studio, configuring a model (OpenAI, DeepSeek, any OpenAI-compatible service), the standalone editor
- [Security](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/SECURITY.md): threat model of the local studio, keys and pictures

## Formats

- [Spec schema (booth-spec-v2)](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/booth-image-to-model/schemas/booth-spec-v2.schema.json): the parametric model
- [Scene description schema](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/booth-image-to-model/schemas/scene-description.v1.json): what is read from the picture, in pixels and plain numbers
- [Data contract](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/booth-image-to-model/references/data-contract.md) (Chinese): coordinates, parameters and states
- [Scene description guide](https://github.com/ocrevo/booth-image-to-model/blob/main/booth-image-to-model/references/scene-description.md) (Chinese)
